Draw ONLY a very small polite chin-down acknowledgment nod. Head, hair and attached ponytail move together about ONE logical pixel lower; scarf and cape remain faithful and stationary. Preserve original head size and body proportions, exact source palette, hard chunky enlarged LPC pixel grid. All garment/arms/hands/waist/legs/feet below collar remain unchanged. Transparent background, generous margins, same 3:1 proportions as 768x256 reference. No text, labels, tools, weapons, shadows, floor, base, additional ornaments or glow. Minor dialogue opening pose, no attack or spell.
